title: Step 8 never returns a planned frame while a picture can be had, never writes a file narrower than its slot minWidth, and never shows one owner photo twice in one block as a near duplicate
steps: S1: From the checkout run the run command (three picture step test files, one at a time).
S2: Read the result of each named test.
expect: A specific frame the kit cannot hide whose every picture is rejected for a cut-off subject is not returned: it is drawn in two other compositions (centred, whole, with a margin, in the frame's 4:3 shape) and then keeps the best rejected drawing with filledBy { rung: best-rejected, faults: [subject cut off] }; L01 notes it instead of failing it and the export writes it.
A frame whose every picture had a hard fault is still returned, and the mapping export lists it in problems as 'the plan wants a picture here and the picture step left it without one'.

An owner photo region narrower than the slot fit.minWidth is refused (narrower-than-min-width); every written file is at least minWidth wide; the export and packageItems(pictures, contentMap) name a narrower file as a problem.

No gallery block shows one owner photo twice as a near duplicate: two cuts of one photo in one block share at most 50%; a second cut sharing 30% passes P06 and the export, one sharing 97% fails P06 and the export leaves it out as a problem; a tile with no such cut left is drawn (filledBy { rung: draw }).

selectors.ladder: RUNGS in apps/tracy-web/src/site-pictures/ladder-rungs.js; bestRejectedRung and drawRung in ladder-climb.js
selectors.minWidth: writeRect and outputSizeFor in apps/tracy-web/src/site-pictures/cut-photo.js; packageItems in apps/tracy-web/src/write-step/picture-package.js
selectors.block: ANY_PHOTO_MAX_OVERLAP in apps/tracy-web/src/site-pictures/gallery-tiles.js; anyPhotoRung in ladder-reuse.js; checkP06 in picture-check/rules-sources.js

evidence: 06/11/2026, cards AJ, AI, AK on a sealed JA Boxing 1.0.11 step 8 batch: four frames returned with no step picking them up (demo picture kept), three frames refused by the write door as SLOT_IMAGE_TOO_SMALL, two gallery tiles holding the same owner photo with cuts sharing 97%.
fence: The finisher (createFinisher) on invented fixtures with fake drawer and looker doors, cutPhoto on generated photos, the picture check and the mapping export. Not exercised: a real drawing or looking model, the Postgres-backed bench, a real site write.

tests: a frame the plan wants filled that cannot be hidden keeps the best picture whose only fault is minor
a frame that cannot be hidden takes another composition the looker passes
every rung of the ladder, in order
the index carries the slot minimum width onto its frame
a picture is written at least the frame minimum width wide
an owner photo whose usable region is narrower than the frame minimum width is refused
the export leaves out a file narrower than its frame minimum width
one gallery block shows an owner photo again only in a clearly different cut
